title: Potential-field directional anisotropy (PAF-DVA) as an independent View A; anisotropy disagreement as the buried-fault discovery signal
lane: the standing brief's co-training paragraph (Blum & Mitchell, COLT '98, doi:10.1145/279943.279962): View A potential-field/subsurface vs View B surface, disagreement as the discovery signal
hypothesis: Directional semivariance anisotropy measured on the potential-field and subsurface bands (isostatic gravity anomaly and its horizontal gradient, reduced-to-pole magnetics, depth to basement) is a texture of the SUBSURFACE that is not a copy of the detrended-elevation texture. Fault damage zones and basement offsets imprint a preferred direction on the semivariance of those longer-wavelength fields, so where the View-A anisotropy is confident and the View-B (surface) anisotropy abstains, the fault may be buried beneath cover and therefore missing from the surface-expression USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
mechanism: A fault offsets and fractures rock over a damage zone of hundreds of metres. Fracturing lowers density and, where hydrothermal fluids circulate, destroys magnetite, so the isostatic gravity and reduced-to-pole magnetic fields carry a directional roughness (semivariance) parallel to the fault that the DEM cannot see below cover. The H82 operator (8-direction integer fan, lags 100-600 m, sigma 3 px) resolves the perpendicular at 22.5 degrees and is the best-measured feature family in this repository (B_DVA2 HOLDOUT-DTI 0.189200 [0.167891, 0.209115]); H97 applies that same operator to View A instead of View B and uses the cross-view DISAGREEMENT as the emission field.
mimic: Named non-fault processes that produce the same signature: (1) lithologic and intrusive contacts in the same fields, especially Tertiary volcanic flow margins that show in depth-to-basement; (2) basin-margin facies steps and the range-front bajada toe; (3) airborne-survey flight-line and levelling striping in the magnetic and radiometric grids, which is directional by construction; (4) karst/paleochannel scour at the basement surface; (5) regional isostatic and terrain-correction artefacts in the gravity grid. Every emitted cell carries its own reasoning row naming which of these it could be.

views.view_A: shared store columns view_A_with_external (gravity, magnetics, strain, seismicity, depth-to-basement, conductivity) PLUS 40 new PAF-DVA channels
views.view_B: shared store columns view_B_with_external (detrended elevation, its slope, DEM curvature/coherence, radiometric K/Th/U and ratios) PLUS 20 new surface-DVA channels
views.overlap_policy: the two column lists must be disjoint; run_h61.setup already enforces disjointness on its own lists and run_h97 re-checks the union it builds

channels.operator: run_h82._gamma_stats verbatim (shared, not forked): standardized band, running max/min/mean of the Gaussian-smoothed semivariance over the 8-direction integer fan, aniso = (max-min)/(max+min), logvar = log10(mean)
channels.excluded_by_design: band 6 (radiometric total count) is NOT given a DVA channel this round: an airborne gamma-ray count grid carries survey-footprint striping that is directional by construction, and including it would make the View-B surface-anisotropy field partly a survey-geometry artefact. Excluded in advance, not after seeing a result.

arm_definitions.cotrain_disagree: PRIMARY: within each fold's allowed set, ranking of (rank(A2) - rank(B2)); positive where View A is more confident than View B
arm_definitions.buried_only: ranking of rank(A2) restricted to cells where rank(B2) <= 0.5 (A confident, B abstains)
arm_definitions.random: uniform random over the same allowed set, same budget

holdout.evaluator: gems52.evaluate_holdout (gems52-pooled-hide-v1), unmodified; alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
holdout.folds: gems52.spatial.folds (label-blind-quadrants-v2) with the registered buffer, rebuilt from the pinned rasters
holdout.ci: 1000 paired physical spatial-cluster bootstrap draws (200 px blocks)

budget_selection_frozen_before_fit.rule: the artifact's emitted mass is chosen on the SAME hide-and-recover instrument from the sweep {9400, 16000, 25400} dots per fold for the primary arm only; take the smallest budget whose pooled DTI is within 0.002 of the best measured value (tie-break toward less mass, per knowledge/76 which measures Spearman(mass, board score) = -0.93 over this family's twelve scored files). If the sweep picks 9400, the artifact emits 9400 dots x 4 folds = 37600 only if the four fold fields are the artifact's domain; otherwise the artifact emits the selected per-fold budget scaled to its own domain as recorded in the build receipt.
budget_selection_frozen_before_fit.reason_not_recomputed_post_hoc: the sweep is registered here as the budget rule, not as a score; no arm's number is re-tuned after seeing it

promotion_rule_frozen_before_fit: PROMOTE only if BOTH hold: (1) pooled cotrain_disagree minus the best comparable control (max over single_A2, single_B2, consensus, union_max, random) has paired 95% CI lower bound > 0; and (2) pooled cotrain_disagree >= 0.190147 (the standing promotable best, knowledge/73). Otherwise the verdict is NEGATIVE and the artifact ships as a research candidate with submit_ok false. Attribution arms are not promotable post hoc.
leakage_canary: every new channel alone, direction-insensitive AUC on the held-out region; alarm bar 0.90
independence_test: the brief's mandated test: spatial-block correlation of the two views' out-of-fold errors on labelled negatives, thresholds inherited verbatim from registry/h74_preregistration.json; abandon if |rho| > 0.60
budget_stop: 3 experiments or 2 hours; no submission slot is spent by this round

amendment_h97a.change: the artifact's emitted mass is FROZEN at 37,600 dots (= 4 x 9,400 per-fold budget, the family standard and the champion's 37,654 px mass). The pre-registered budget sweep {9400, 16000, 25400} is DEMOTED to a diagnostic: it is reported as a curve but it does NOT select the budget.
amendment_h97a.reason: knowledge/76 sec.6 and evidence/h83_budget_curve.json measure that the hide-and-recover instruments over-reward recall (off-catalogue truth is ~4x the estimated real prevalence), and knowledge/76 sec.6 states explicitly that these instruments are 'not valid for choosing the budget'. Selecting the artifact's mass from a sweep on such an instrument would repeat a defect this repository has already logged. Freezing the budget at the family standard keeps H97 comparable with H82/H89/H96 and leaves the mass lever to the selector step.
amendment_h97a.unchanged: arms, channels, holdout, canary, independence thresholds and the promotion rule are exactly as frozen in the un-amended preregistration
